proposal.reason: Main change is in transport: intra-node P2P/SHM/NET path selection behavior, connection setup synchronization/progress accounting, and P2P setup/teardown logic. Added device-topology because selection now depends on new GPU↔NET path-bandwidth checks (`ncclTopoCheckNet`) and path computation updates. Added memory because SHM/IPC buffer ownership and lifecycle were substantively changed via new shareable-buffer descriptors/handles, import/close flows, and registered-address table handling semantics.
